title: Governed temporal feasibility for state-changing prescribed root uptake
required_production_authority: PPA-ROOT-HYD01 R1 qualified restricted prescribed root-sink temporal certificate
purpose: Test whether the frozen Stage 0 0.1 cm temporal head-error budget can actually admit a nonzero state-changing prescribed root sink without changing physics, tolerances or the governed budget.

paired_control.definition: same sink vector through one ordinary drainage/source-sink level with root extraction inactive
paired_control.purpose: Verify complete adaptive transaction equivalence of the admitted prescribed ROOT carrier and the already admitted generic sink carrier.

pass_gates: ROOT completes requested 0.1 day interval and returns ready candidate
ROOT hard mass ledger is complete and absolute residual <=1e-12 cm
ROOT accepted state differs from initial equilibrium state
ROOT temporal certificate route is available and reference-richards-raw-bound
GENERIC control also completes with hard mass
ROOT and GENERIC final pressure head and water content agree at 64*epsilon scaled tolerance
ROOT and GENERIC retry/solver-rejection/temporal-rejection counts are identical
forbidden_after_execution: change solver tolerances to obtain pass
